name: batch-image-compress
title: Batch Image Compress & Convert — WebP/JPEG/PNG
description: Batch WebP/JPEG/PNG optimization pipeline for image URL lists (or batch-image-downloader dataset/KV fields). Outputs KV files plus bytesBefore/After, savedPct, dims, sha256. Optional EXIF/GPS strip. Failed/non-image free. AVIF is runtime optional / currently unavailable on this runtime — not a selling point. No crawl — differentiate from downloader.
